source_solver: gurobipy 13.0.3 (Gurobi Optimizer 13.0.3, size-limited pip licence); original notebook airlineplanning.ipynb code cells run via exec on 2026-11-02 with the notebook's data/*.csv (n_airports = 4, alpha = 0.5, the notebook defaults); %pip/!apt, plotting, graphviz and ipywidgets lines dropped; one pandas-3 patch: groupby(['aircraft']).apply(lambda x: x['flight'].tolist()) -> groupby('aircraft')['flight'].apply(list)
notes: Gurobi reports ObjVal 561087 (objective constant 1,878,476 = revenue of all planned flights), status optimal, gap 0, NumVars 1930 (264 x incl. 42 source/sink pseudo-flights + 1666 y arcs), NumConstrs 536, NumIntVars 1930 (all binary), 5772 nonzeros; the port has the same counts and nonzeros. It prints 51 flights served, 6570 passengers, 9 aircraft used. The notebook's main model (cells 27-39) is ported; the interactive 'Full model' cell 44 is the same model under an alpha slider. Data: the 222 flights between the notebook's top-4 airports by degree (ORY, CDG, LYS, NCE) of the 608 in flight_rotations_2006-07-01.csv, their 21 aircraft, and per-flight revenue (sum of cost * n_pass) and passengers from flight_iterinaries.csv (77 flights have bookings; the others have revenue 0, as the original skips them in the objective). Times are minutes after midnight; the source/sink times 00:00 and 23:59 are structural. Notebook quirks reproduced: (1) both the source and the sink pseudo-flight of an aircraft get origin = end airport and destination = start airport; (2) they have x variables and count in the airport capacity rows, both in the LHS and in the normal-day totals the 0.5 multiplies (x[source] is free, x[sink] is forced to 0 by an empty x <= 0 row); (3) a flight departing at 00:00 cannot be first (strict 00:00 < departure). Reformulation: none. The single alpha becomes airports.capacity_share (0.5 at every airport). Even at capacity_share 1 the port loses 492,049.5 (the 4-airport cut leaves many rotations unable to chain from start to end airport). Alternative optima: lost_revenue, revenue_kept, passengers_carried (6570) and revenue_flights_operated (51) are unique; flights_operated (51..123) and aircraft_used (9..13) are not, since zero-revenue flights can be flown or not within capacity.
